Closes #345536

## Purpose

Test-only PR for forwarding screenshot CI reports to a linked issue on merge. This description intentionally contains no embedded images or videos, so description media cannot mask a screenshot-only forwarding failure. This is not a VS Code product fix.

## Change

Change one test-data label in the existing [button bar fixture](src/vs/workbench/test/browser/componentFixtures/buttonBar.fixture.ts) from `Publish Branch` to `Publish Test Branch`. The screenshot CI report contains the intended Before/After change for `platform/buttonBar/Buttons/Light`, without changing production behavior. The head branch is in this repository because the screenshot workflow only posts bot reports for non-fork PRs.

## Validation

- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/workbench/test/browser/componentFixtures/buttonBar.fixture.ts` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- The normal commit hook ran and passed hygiene for the changed file.
- The [Component Fixtures workflow](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/actions/runs/41432984030) — passed, including `Screenshots`, `Playwright Fixture Tests`, and `Screenshots & Tests`. The [authentic bot report](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/345539#issuecomment-6575485938) contains the intended screenshot change.
- Local Component Explorer preview was not run: its MCP server could not initialize inside the sandbox. Rendering and report publication were validated by the CI screenshot job instead.
- Full unit tests and client type-check were not run for this test-data-only string change.

## How to Run the Test

1. Wait for the Component Fixtures screenshot job and confirm the latest `github-actions[bot]` comment starts with `<!-- screenshot-diff-report -->` and contains the intended screenshot changes. Do not copy the report into this description.
2. A separate ordinary PR comment contains an unrelated image as a negative control; it must not be forwarded as a screenshot CI report.
3. When a maintainer intentionally wants to run the merge-triggered test, mark this draft ready and merge it. Closing it without merging is not sufficient. No merge is requested as part of creating these artifacts.
4. Check #345536 for the forwarded latest screenshot report. Screenshot names, Before/After tables, expandable sections, and a link to the original PR report should be preserved despite this description having no media. The ordinary-comment control image should be absent.

This pair covers the positive screenshot-only case and the ordinary-comment control. Testing a latest report without media, older-report fallback, and existing description-media forwarding requires separate runs.

## Cleanup

Keep this PR as a draft until the test is intentional. After verification, restore the fixture label if desired. The one-line change is only test data; there is no production behavior to retain.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: Create the existing action, render its label into one existing button, perform browser layout, then capture the fixture. The diff changes only the constant label text.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One label in one of nine fixed rows per fixture render.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single synchronous render with no boundary-call concurrency or backpressure.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache participates; cold and warm execution have the same fixed work.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High; the sole changed line replaces one string literal used by one row of a fixed test fixture.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Text measurement is not benchmarked, but only one fixed label is affected, so cost does not scale.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression because no new layout pass, repeated work, boundary, retained state, or concurrency is introduced.

Analysis.Summary: Performance review complete. The one-line test-fixture label change introduces no actionable performance regression and fixes no established regression.
